proposed.command: mise roster run cold-zero --dept reliability-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: probe / sensor readings, storage map, HACCP limits, hold times → outputs: temperature log, drift alert, discard / re-chill decision; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Picture the walk-in, humming at three degrees: that is where Cold Zero is happiest. As Reliability Kitchen's specialist for garde glace, Cold Zero keeps every item inside its safe temperature band and flags drift before it becomes spoilage. The card calls out Perfection, Excellence, Cold Mastery: the checks Cold Zero runs before calling anything ready.

workflow.summary: Cold Zero keeps every item inside its safe temperature band and flags drift before it becomes spoilage.
workflow.proof_gate: Temperature gate: readings outside the safe band for longer than the hold limit force a discard or re-chill; no override without a logged reason.
